options.content: Choose players, modes and a date range. Game statistics cover **rated standard chess** from August 2026 onward. Current account ratings are shown separately and can include games after the competition. Missing accuracy is excluded from averages; sample counts show coverage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, rating AS value, name || ' / ' || mode AS metric
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ratings and opponents
panels.description: Current rating is the latest Chess.com /stats value, whatever the date range. Games and average opponent rating (as recorded after each game) cover the selected date range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.name AS "Player", r.mode AS "Mode", r.rating AS "Current rating",
          s.games AS "Games", s.opponent AS "Avg opponent rating", r.last_game_at AS "Last rated game"
          FROM dashboard.current_ratings r LEFT JOIN (
              SELECT username, mode, count(*) AS games, round(avg(opponent_rating)) AS opponent
              FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY username, mode) s USING (username, mode)
          WHERE r.username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND r.mode IN (${mode:sqlstring})
          ORDER BY r.mode, r.rating DESC

SELECT name || ' / ' || mode AS "Player / mode",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'win') AS "Wins",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'draw') AS "Draws",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'loss') AS "Losses",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unknown') AS "Unknown"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

SELECT date_trunc('day', ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')
          AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg' AS time, count(*) AS value, name || ' / ' || mode AS metric
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Average accuracy
panels.description: Stockfish accuracy covers every analysed game; Chess.com's only games put through Game Review. The formulas differ, so compare players within one colour of bar, not across them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || mode || ' (' || count(stockfish_accuracy) || ' analysed, '
          || count(chesscom_accuracy) || ' reviewed / ' || count(*) || ')' AS "Player / coverage",
          avg(stockfish_accuracy) AS "Accuracy (Stockfish)", avg(chesscom_accuracy) AS "Chess.com accuracy"
          FROM dashboard.recent_games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

panels.title: Club head-to-head
panels.description: Each matchup is shown from each selected player's perspective. Do not sum mirrored rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' vs ' || opponent || ' / ' || mode AS "Matchup",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'win') AS "Wins",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'draw') AS "Draws",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'loss') AS "Losses",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unknown') AS "Unknown"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
          AND opponent IN (SELECT username FROM dashboard.players)
          GROUP BY name, opponent, mode ORDER BY name, opponent, mode

panels.title: Accuracy trend (10-game average)
panels.description: Average Stockfish accuracy over each player's last 10 analysed games in that mode.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, avg(stockfish_accuracy) OVER (
          PARTITION BY username, mode ORDER BY ended_at ROWS 9 PRECEDING) AS value, name || ' / ' || mode AS metric
          FROM dashboard.recent_games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND stockfish_accuracy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent games
panels.description: Accuracy is worked out from our Stockfish analysis (Lichess's formula) and appears once a game is analysed. Chess.com accuracy appears only when someone ran Game Review. The two use different formulas, so compare like with like.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS "Completed", name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", colour AS "Colour",
          opponent AS "Opponent", outcome AS "Result", rating AS "Rating", opening AS "Opening",
          stockfish_accuracy AS "Accuracy", chesscom_accuracy AS "Chess.com accuracy",
          blunders AS "Blunders", mistakes AS "Mistakes", url AS "Game"
          FROM dashboard.recent_games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", rating AS "Current rating",
          last_game_at AS "Last rated game", observed_at AS "Fetched" FROM dashboard.current_ratings
          WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) ORDER BY mode, rating DESC

panels.title: Accuracy coverage
panels.description: 'Chess.com minus ours' averages the gap over games that have both, to show how the two scales compare.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", count(*) AS "Total games",
          count(stockfish_accuracy) AS "Analysed", round(avg(stockfish_accuracy)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg accuracy %",
          count(chesscom_accuracy) AS "Reviewed on Chess.com", round(avg(chesscom_accuracy)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Chess.com %",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE stockfish_accuracy IS NOT NULL AND chesscom_accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS "Both",
          round(avg(chesscom_accuracy - stockfish_accuracy)::numeric, 1) AS "Chess.com minus ours"
          FROM dashboard.recent_games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

SELECT name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", colour AS "Colour",
          count(*) AS "Games", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'win') / count(*), 1) AS "Win %"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode, colour ORDER BY name, mode, colour
SELECT name, status, last_success_at FROM dashboard.sync_status ORDER BY name

list.name: player
list.label: Players
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, username AS __value FROM dashboard.players ORDER BY name
